description: This file defines a React component for an event detail page in a ticketing web application. It manages various tabs related to event management, such as overview, ticket types, generation, CSV import, check-in scanning, and reports. It also handles fetching event data and downloading tickets as a ZIP archive.

methods.name: downloadAll
methods.description: Asynchronously downloads a ZIP archive of all tickets for the current event and saves it locally. Sets an error message if download fails.
